title: Persistent homology over a wide variety of real biological datasets
preregistration: topodb_runs/biology/expectations.json, committed alone at dde7a07 before any biological persistence diagram was computed
binding_method_rules: (a) A non-Euclidean metric (Hi-C contact, scRNA correlation, sequence Hamming) is given to Rips DIRECTLY. No MDS-then-alpha anywhere: that route produced a FALSE loop of dominance 11.1 on the tree-like influenza HA segment in the earlier validation. bio_common.py contains no MDS function.
(b) Alpha is used only on genuinely Euclidean coordinates (protein/RNA atoms).

gudhi: create_simplex_tree(max_dimension = max_hom_dim + 1), since a d-skeleton yields homology only to d-1. Step 0 runs through the same helpers, so a regression would show there as b1 = 0 on the circle.

decision.note: criterion (i) is two-sided: the pre-registered direction is all-alpha > all-beta, so an AUC well below 0.5 is a separation in the OPPOSITE direction and is reported as such

100.desc: normal sinus rhythm (69 M); periodic, dominant H1 expected

207.desc: severe arrhythmia incl. ventricular flutter; no expectation stated

datasets.title: LABELLED SYNTHETIC: bio_datasets/01_hic_contact_map.npy (named as Hi-C, generated from coordinates)
datasets.source: local file /mnt/disks/disk-socrateai-local-1/bio_datasets/01_hic_contact_map.npy; no upstream URL exists
datasets.notes: NOT DATA. Recomputed evidence: {"n_bins": 500, "spearman_contact_vs_coordinate_distance": -1.0, "frac_offdiag_exactly_zero": 0.0, "diagonal_unique_values": [15.848931925], "n_files_in_directory": 22, "mtime_span_seconds": 0.7861, "coords_shape": [500, 3]}. A measured Hi-C matrix is never an exactly monotone function of a coordinate set's pairwise distances, never has zero off-diagonal zeros, and does not have a constant diagonal. Ingested only so that a query for Hi-C in this database meets it labelled as a synthetic control rather than as an observation.

params.metric: contact^(-1/3) fed directly to Rips (NO embedding)

runs.preprocessing: diagonal zeroed; no other cleaning was needed (there are no off-diagonal zeros, which is itself the tell)

controls.description: provenance check: a real Hi-C contact matrix cannot be an exactly monotone function of a coordinate set's distances
controls.detail: Spearman(contact, coordinate distance) = -1.000000; 0.000 of off-diagonal entries are zero; the whole directory was written within 0.7861 s

findings.claim: bio_datasets/01_hic_contact_map.npy is synthetic, not Hi-C: it is an exactly monotone function of 01_hic_chromatin_coords (Spearman -1.0000), it has no off-diagonal zeros, and all 22 files in that directory were written within 0.7861 s. Its Rips H1 dominance is 1.10. It is recorded as a synthetic control and is used as data nowhere in this block.
findings.caveat: the mtime span is filesystem metadata, which is suggestive rather than conclusive on its own; the Spearman -1 relation is the decisive evidence

datasets.title: Cross-implementation reproduction check: this block vs the 2026-09-19 genetics validation
datasets.notes: Not a biological dataset: an analysis-level record comparing two independently written implementations of 'Rips on the given metric' over the same raw files.

params.check: numerical agreement with the earlier validation's Rips cross-check
params.metric: n/a -- this run compares previously computed numbers

controls.description: two independent implementations must give the same persistence statistics on the same raw files

findings.claim: 33 of 33 persistence statistics computed here agree with the 2026-09-19 genetics validation to a relative 0.0001, using independently written code on the same raw files.
findings.caveat: this checks implementation agreement, not biological truth; both implementations could share a conceptual error, and the earlier run's own verdicts (Caulobacter FAIL, E. coli PASS, influenza PASS) are unchanged by it
